# viettelcloud_key_pair (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud SSH key pair. A generated private key is returned only during creation and stored in Terraform state. Protect the state because marking private_key as sensitive does not encrypt it. The backend does not return the private key during refresh or import, so it cannot be recovered if state is lost.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generate a new SSH key pair. Terraform stores the returned private key in
# state; protect the state because sensitive values are not encrypted.
resource "viettelcloud_key_pair" "generated" {
  name = "example-generated-key"
}

# Upload an existing SSH public key.
resource "viettelcloud_key_pair" "uploaded" {
  name       = "example-imported-key"
  public_key = "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQC3... user@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key pair.

### Optional

- `public_key` (String) Public key material to upload. On create, omit it to generate a new key pair. Changing a configured value replaces the key pair; removing it from configuration preserves the existing public key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the key pair was created (RFC3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key pair.
- `id` (String) Key pair ID (UUID).
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key returned only when the platform generates the pair during creation. It is stored in Terraform state. The backend does not return it during refresh or import, so it cannot be recovered if state is lost.
- `type` (String) Type of the key pair (e.g. rsa).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the key pair was last updated (RFC3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a key pair by ID. The backend cannot return an existing private key,
# so private_key is null after import.
terraform import viettelcloud_key_pair.example 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789
```
